transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m just worn out, doctor. Like, really worn out. Even getting from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. I used to know a guy who did that kind of work, and he’d come home just covered in sawdust, you know… anyway, that’s what it feels like, except I haven’t done anything. And resting doesn’t seem to give me anything back.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah… yeah, I have. I used to look forward to choir, and playing a little pickup ball, working on cars—my brother had this old Chevy we were always messing with, never did get the carburetor right—and grilling for the family on weekends. I used to like being the guy at the grill, you know?

Now I just… I can’t make myself care enough to go. People text me about choir or getting together, and I’ll see it there on the phone and just not answer. It feels like too much, even when I know I used to enjoy it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About… four months, I think. It kind of started after my wife went back to working full-time. She’s out most weekdays now, and I’m just there alone in the house, and the days sort of stretch out. I’ll hear the refrigerator kick on, or a car go by, and suddenly it’s afternoon. So… yeah, around four months.
Have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re a burden or not good enough?

Yeah… I do. A lot. I keep thinking I failed my wife, and my kids, and even the church. Like I was supposed to be… I don’t know, stronger, steadier, the kind of man people can lean on.

And now every little bad thing that happens around us, I start thinking it’s because of me somehow. Like it’s punishment for me not being who I was supposed to be. I know that probably sounds… I don’t know. But it’s hard to shake.
Have you ever had periods where your mood was unusually high, irritable, or you felt extremely energetic or invincible?

I don’t… I don’t think so. I mean, I get irritable sometimes, sure, but not like I’m on top of the world or anything.

Energetic… no. If anything, people used to say I had a lot of get-up-and-go, back when I was younger—my dad used to make me mow two lawns in one Saturday and still expect me to help him with the garage after—but that wasn’t like what you’re saying, I don’t think. Not invincible. Just… busy, I guess.

So, no, I can’t really think of a time like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt so good, full of energy, or restless that people around you noticed a big change in your behavior, or where you didn’t need much sleep but still felt great?

No… I don’t think so. Not like that.

I mean, I’ve had times where I stayed up late, but it was usually for something normal, you know, like helping with something at church or waiting for one of the kids to get home back when they were younger. My wife used to say I could fall asleep in a chair with the TV on—she’d laugh about it, because my father did the same thing.

But feeling great and not needing sleep… people noticing I was different like that… no, I can’t really say I’ve had that.
Have you had any other episodes of feeling this way — with low mood, loss of interest, and fatigue — that lasted for several weeks or more, before this current period of four months?

I don’t know… I’m trying to think. There were hard times, sure. Everybody has those, right? My father used to say you just keep your head down and keep moving, and I guess I did that for a long time.

But episodes like this… several weeks where it was all low and heavy like you’re saying… I’m not sure. I don’t really remember it being like this before. Maybe I had stretches where I was worn out or discouraged, but I couldn’t tell you if it was the same thing or long enough.
Can you think of any other times in your life, before this current period, where you felt down or low for several weeks in a row, even if it wasn't exactly like what you're experiencing now?

Before this? I… I don’t know. I’m trying to sort through it.

I’ve had low spells, sure, but this thing now is different. I wake up and it’s like there’s this weight right in my chest, just heavy and hopeless before I’ve even done anything. And some days I end up sitting out in the garage… I’ll just sit there and cry, and I can’t even tell you what started it.

The garage used to be where I’d mess around with tools, you know, little projects, my father had coffee cans full of screws and bolts, never threw anything away… and now I just sit there. So if you mean before all this current stretch, I’m not sure I can point to another time that was like that for weeks. This feels… worse, I guess.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks in a row?

I’m not sure I can say that clearly. I mean… more than two weeks, that sounds like something I should be able to remember, but it all kind of blurs together when I look back.

There were times I was down, sure. Life piles up. But losing interest in things for that long… before this? I can’t really point to a stretch and say yes, that was it. My wife used to keep the calendar better than me—appointments, birthdays, all that—so maybe she’d remember things different, but from my side, I just don’t know.
Before this current period, have you ever had any other time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy for at least two weeks in a row?

I wish I could give you a straight yes or no, but I honestly don’t know. I’ve had times where I was tired or down, I guess, but whether it was two full weeks in a row before this… I can’t pin it down.

It’s funny, I can remember useless things, like the sound our old refrigerator made in the kitchen at night, or where my dad kept the spare fuses in the basement, but when you ask me to line up how I felt back then, it just sort of… slips around. So I don’t think I can say for sure there was another time like that.

Before this current period of feeling down, have you ever had any other distinct times when you felt this way—like you’ve lost interest in things, had no energy, or felt down—for at least two weeks in a row?

I don’t really have a clear one to point to. I know you’ve asked it a few ways, and I’m trying not to dodge it, but when I look back it’s all kind of foggy.

I’ve had rough patches, sure… everybody does, I guess. There were times I didn’t feel like doing much, or I’d get tired of things, but whether that was a separate, distinct stretch for two weeks or more before this… I can’t honestly say. I can remember dumb details, like the old street we lived on and the neighbor’s dog barking all night, but not that clearly. So… I don’t know. Nothing definite comes to mind.
Can you think of any distinct times in your life, before this current period, when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy for at least two weeks in a row?

I still can’t really come up with a distinct time like that. I keep trying to sort it out, but it’s like looking through old boxes in the garage—everything’s there somewhere, but nothing’s labeled right.

I remember periods where I was worn out or not very interested in much, but I can’t say, “yes, that was two weeks in a row,” not before this. And then my mind goes to other things, like old jobs I had, or classes I started and didn’t finish, and I lose the thread.

So… no clear answer, I guess. I don’t know of a definite time before this one.
Have you ever had any other times in your life, before this current period, when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I know I’m probably sounding like a broken record, but I really can’t say for sure. Before this… I don’t have a clean memory of some other two-week stretch like that.

There were times I wasn’t doing great, I guess, but then I start thinking about where I was living then, or what job I had, and I get sidetracked. Like I can remember the bus route I used to take better than how long I felt low. So… I don’t know. I can’t point to another definite time.
Have you ever had any other times in your life, even before this current period, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m sorry, I know I’m circling the same drain here, but I really don’t know. I can’t pull up a clear “yes, that happened for two weeks” from before this.

I mean, I can remember bits and pieces—where I used to keep my tools, this one cracked sidewalk near an old place I lived—but when it comes to how long I felt down or uninterested back then, it gets blurry. Maybe there were times I wasn’t myself, but I can’t honestly say it lasted that long or that it was separate from everything else.

So… I don’t have a definite one to tell you.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m trying to answer you straight, but I just don’t have a solid memory of that before now. Like, I can think of being tired at different points, or kind of drifting, but then I start remembering other stuff—where I parked my car at this old apartment, the way the kitchen light used to flicker—and I can’t pin down the feeling part.

So… before this current period, I can’t really say there was a time like that for two weeks in a row. I don’t know.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I don’t really know how to separate it out before this. I’m not trying to be difficult—I just… I can remember certain places better than I can remember how I felt. Like the layout of an old room, or what I used to do in the mornings, little things like that.

But whether I was down or had no energy for two straight weeks before this? I can’t honestly say. I don’t have a clear example of that.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I keep trying to check back in my head, but it’s like the more I look for it, the more it slips sideways. Before this… I don’t have a clean memory of a stretch like that.

There were periods where life felt kind of flat, I guess, but then I’m thinking about where I was living, or the job I had before I stopped working, or some random class I took years ago, and I lose the thread. I can’t say, “yes, that was two weeks” or “yes, that was the same thing.” I just don’t know for sure.

Have you ever had any times in your life before this current period, even if they were shorter or less intense, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I hear what you’re asking, like even smaller versions of it before now… but I still can’t really give you a clean yes. I can remember being worn out sometimes, or not wanting to do much, but then I start thinking about the old bus route I used to take, or this one grocery store that had the strange parking lot, and I lose track of whether that was a mood thing or just life being… life.

So, before this current period, I don’t know. I don’t have a specific stretch I can point to and say it was two weeks in a row.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I know you’ve asked it a few ways, and I’m trying not to just circle around it. I honestly don’t have a solid answer.

Before this, I can remember bits and pieces—like where I was living, or certain routines, even dumb things like what the kitchen looked like or where I kept my keys—but I can’t line it up with, “yes, I felt down for two weeks,” or “yes, I had no energy that whole time.” It just doesn’t come together like that for me.

So… I’m not saying it definitely never happened. I just can’t point to a time before this and say for sure that it did.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down, lost interest in things, or had no energy that lasted for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m sorry, I know I’m not giving you the straight answer you’re looking for. I just… I can’t really place it.

Before this, there were times I felt tired or kind of low, I guess, but then my mind jumps to other things, like where I was living or what my schedule was, and I start doubting whether I’m remembering a mood or just remembering the place. I don’t have a clear two-week stretch I can point to and say, yes, that was it.
